voice.name: clean-import
voice.text: You can import a Google Sheet link or an Excel file. Here, we'll use the link. Choose the buildings, then add the spreadsheet.

voice.name: clean-sellers
voice.text: On Sellers, you can filter by status: prospect, market appraisal, for sale, or not interested.

voice.name: clean-context
voice.text: Sold today shows fresh transactions in that building. Open a seller to see the sales, dates and prices.

voice.name: clean-automation
voice.text: With WhatsApp connected, eligible sellers get automated updates using those transactions.

voice.name: clean-template
voice.text: You can use the default message or write your own. Here, we'll add a name, a building and recent sales. The preview updates as you type.

voice.name: clean-schedule-a
voice.text: Next, choose which buildings get messages on each day. Pick a spreadsheet, select its building, and repeat for the other days.

voice.name: clean-schedule-b
voice.text: We've filled Monday through Thursday. Now save the plan. Empty days stay off.

voice.name: clean-market
voice.text: To track price drops, open a building and choose an apartment. The chart shows the asking price.

voice.name: clean-market-activity
voice.text: Open Activity to see when that price changed.

voice.name: clean-tools
voice.text: Connect your spreadsheets, email and calendars.

voice.name: clean-assistant-v2
voice.text: You can also type or speak to Ask Repeat. It can find sellers, summarise the market, and prepare changes, like a new template.

voice.name: clean-platforms
voice.text: Repeat A I works on web, Windows and mobile.
